label: Shizuku
description: Shizuku for droidtop: a status tile and actions for the Shizuku app, and ADB-level privilege for other plugins and for droidtop itself (ending another app's game from Quit to Library), each only after you allow it.

permissions.reason: Open Shizuku so you can start it and allow droidtop
Talks to Shizuku's binder from droidtop's own process, which is where Shizuku allows droidtop
Lets other plugins and droidtop run ADB-level commands through Shizuku, each only after you allow it
